type.description: One of: comment, task, create, status_changed, priority_changed, assignee_changed, unassigned, due_date_changed, title_changed, description_changed, cycle_changed, module_added, module_removed, estimate_changed, start_date_changed, label_added, label_removed, relation_added, relation_removed, parent_changed, subtask_added, subtask_removed, link_added, link_updated, link_removed, attachment_added, attachment_removed, copied_from, copied_to, archived, unarchived.Assignee rows are per person: assignee_changed carries newAssigneeId, newAssignee (name) and isSelfAssigned in eventData; unassigned carries oldAssigneeId, oldAssignee (name) and isSelfUnassigned (older unassigned rows have no eventData and mean the whole task was unassigned). cycle_changed carries oldCycleId, oldCycleName, newCycleId and newCycleName in eventData, plus reason=cycle_deleted when the old cycle was deleted. module_added and module_removed carry moduleId and moduleName, plus reason=module_deleted when the module was deleted. estimate_changed carries oldPointId, newPointId, oldValue, newValue (value text at the time, minutes for time systems) and oldType, newType (points, categories or time), plus a reason (point_deleted, system_switched, system_deleted or task_moved) when it was not a direct edit. Task-detail types keep snapshots so they stay readable after renames and deletes; a task reference is { id, key, title, projectId }: start_date_changed carries oldStartDate and newStartDate (ISO or null); label_added and label_removed carry name and color; description_changed carries nothing (saves by the same person within 10 minutes share one row); relation_added and relation_removed are written on both tasks and carry relation (the key from that task's side: blocked_by, blocking, related, duplicate, start_before, start_after, finish_before or finish_after), otherTaskId, otherTaskKey, otherTaskTitle and otherProjectId; parent_changed carries oldParent and newParent (task references or null); subtask_added and subtask_removed (on the parent) carry otherTaskId, otherTaskKey, otherTaskTitle and otherProjectId of the sub-task; link_added, link_updated and link_removed carry linkId, url, title and host (link_updated also oldUrl and oldTitle); attachment_added and attachment_removed carry attachmentId, filename, size and mimeType; copied_from (on the copy) carries sourceTaskId, sourceTaskKey, sourceTaskTitle, sourceProjectId and included (option keys); copied_to (on the source) carries copyTaskId, copyTaskKey, copyTaskTitle and copyProjectId.

eventData.description: Type-specific payload. Task notifications carry { taskTitle, taskKey, projectId, workspaceId, actorName }, plus { oldStatus, newStatus } for status changes, { commenterName, commentId, commentPreview } for comments, { mentionerName, source, commentId, commentPreview } for mentions, { field, oldValue, newValue } for task_updated (field is priority, dueDate or title), { leadTimeMinutes, dueDate, dueDay } for reminders (dueDay is the due date's day in the recipient's time zone), and { pageTitle, mentionerName, projectId, workspaceId } for page_mention (resourceType page).

task.description: The notification's task, read fresh (current title). Null for non-task notifications and deleted tasks.

ideal.description: The straight burn-down line from scope to 0.

name.description: Null for tasks without labels (listed last). A task with several labels counts in each.

enabled.description: True when the project's estimates feature is on and a system is active. When false, every count is 0, every sum is null and distribution is empty.

total.description: Sum of the values; null unless the system is numeric.

position.description: Manual order, ascending; new modules go first.

progress.description: Percent done, 0–100: completed ÷ (total − cancelled), rounded. 0 without tasks, 100 when every task is cancelled.

members.description: Ordered by name. Users who left the workspace are still listed.

removedTaskIds.description: The tasks the module held; they stay in the project.

today.description: The server's UTC date the chart was computed against.

allOf.description: Estimate totals over the same tasks. enabled is false while the project's estimates feature is off or no system is active.

numericValue.description: The value as a number (minutes for time); null for categories.

snoozedUntil.description: Set only while the request is snoozed.
